how_to_revise: Edit this file, raise the version, set status to APPROVED when the owner signs it off, commit and deploy. A price of null shows as 'Price to be announced'. The free allowance itself is a platform setting (Admin, Access and Subscriptions), not this file; the gate stays OFF until that number is set. 'coins' is what a plan costs in Coins and 'days' how long it lasts; the price in cedis is coins times the unit price set on Admin, Access and Subscriptions (Payments). A plan with no 'coins' is not sold online.
